overall_status: UNTESTED: free-multi-descendant throw text, spacebase/written/input accumulation and push order byte-match the locked oracle
architecture: locked synthetic LE 64-bit Architecture: const=0, other=1, unique=2, ram=3, register=4, stack=5, join=6, iop=7
compiler_spec: synthetic prototype fixture: extrapop=0, empty input/output, no effect records, no symbols, high-level disabled

analysis_options.entrypoint: direct Varnode::addDescend transitions on bank-created varnodes followed by caught LowlevelError/panic observation
analysis_options.address_model: 64-bit uintb, byte-addressed, all fixture spaces little-endian
analysis_options.throw_channel: Ghidra throws LowlevelError; Rugra panics with identical message, caught via catch_unwind with silenced hook so stderr stays empty
analysis_options.lock_poisoning: Rust unwinding poisons the panicked Varnode's RwLock (no Ghidra counterpart); per-case fresh banks keep later loc_tree Ord reads away from poisoned nodes; post-throw state read via into_inner
analysis_options.test_only_cpp_access: fixture defines private as public after standard headers solely to construct the friend-only PcodeOp/Varnode descendant graph
analysis_options.dead_weak_filtering: Rugra counts only strong_count>0 descend entries; Ghidra's list can never hold a destroyed op (opDestroy erases first), so the filter is unobservable in the oracle and registered as UNTESTED-in-oracle drift semantics

input_manifest.canonicalization: RFC 8785-compatible JSON subset: UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, no floats
cases: free register:0x80 size=8 first addDescend(op1@time=1) accepted; count+flags observed
same free varnode second addDescend(op2@time=2) throws LowlevelError text verbatim; descend count and flags unchanged (throw before push_back/setFlags)
free register:0x88 size=8 flagged spacebase accepts two descendants (varnode.cc:334 !isSpacebase() guard)
createDef register:0x90 size=8 (written) accumulates two descendants without throw
create+setInput register:0x98 size=8 (input) accumulates two descendants without throw
constant const:0x1234 size=4: free by isFree() (written|input clear), no addDescend exemption, second addDescend throws; opSetInput-level dedup is the production protection
descend iteration order after two pushes equals SeqNum time push order (getTime, address.hh:139; 2-arg ctor leaves order field unset)

coverage.dead_weak_entry_filtering: UNTESTED-in-oracle: Ghidra cannot hold a destroyed op in descend; Rugra filters strong_count==0 entries, unobservable in this fixture
coverage.highvariable_cover_dirty_propagation: UNTESTED: bare Varnodes have high==null in both sides; high->flagsDirty()/coverDirty() side effects belong to the cover.cc port roadmap

exact_function_boundaries.add_descend: Only Varnode::addDescend (varnode.cc:330-340) is under test: guard isFree()&&!isSpacebase()&&!descend.empty(), throw text, push_back, setFlags(coverdirty). opSetInput-level constant dedup (funcdata_op.cc:108-115) and opInsertInput routing (funcdata_op.cc:308-318) are upstream callers, not covered here.
exact_function_boundaries.flags_observation: flag bit layout is pinned to the varnode.hh enum order (coverdirty=1<<24, spacebase=1<<17, written=1<<4, insert=1<<5, input=1<<3, constant=1<<1); identical integers on both sides.

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-varnode-adddescend-lib-snapshot-v1 plus sorted length-prefixed relative paths and contents

build.cpp_oracle: full locked decompiler libdecomp.a rebuilt from git archive; fixture compiled in a separate directory against that archive
build.rust_comparand: full byte snapshot of declared Rugra library closure; Cargo.lock-checksummed offline vendor; isolated CARGO_HOME and target
